Gemini.name: Gemini 4 Carbon
Gemini.why: Google calls Gemini 4 Carbon its next frontier model and strongest model, and it is now in the Gemini API for all paying developers, ranking above Argon and the cheaper Hydrogen.

Claude.name: Claude Fable 5.2
Claude.why: Anthropic launched Claude Fable 5.2 on Nov 9, 2026 as its most capable model for technical work and made it generally available on all platforms; Mythos 5.2 is limited to vetted organizations and isn't in this list.

ChatGPT.name: GPT-6 Astra
ChatGPT.why: OpenAI's GPT-6 guide recommends GPT-6 Astra for the most demanding work, and OpenAI describes the newer GPT-6.1 Sol as only nearly matching Astra at a lower price.
